content.raw:
Exploring New Frontiers in AI, Photography, and Human Connection

Strap in, because I've been riding this rocketship of life at warp speed for the past 3 weeks, and I've got a ton of stories, life hacks, and jaw-dropping moments to share with you!

Let's get into the nitty-gritty (check out each link below for original KK videos, podcasts, photos and stories):

  • AI Transit Bot & HackCT: Dived into the world of natural language processing and made public transit cool again. I helped build an AI chatbot providing public transit information and learned about open source solutions.
  • Coffee, Community & Sobriety: Sat down with the legendary Matt McKenna and had an eye-opening convo a fun interview about his journey building Imperial Moto Coffee and involvement over a decade with the Dent community.
  • Master Prompts & AI Mindset: Unpacked my learnings from Kyle Kesterson's workshop. Get ready to have your AI game level up!
  • Portraiture & Photography at Dent: Got my portrait game on with the one and only Asa Mathat. Renowned photographer showcased his talents at Dent, where he also provided guidance to improve my portrait skills.
  • AI: Promise & Peril: Listened to the big brains talk about AI's impact on our world. Key takeaways from a panel on AI's potential and risks from experts like the Space Force CTO.

So grab your favorite brew, settle in, and let's take this journey together! ?

Peace, Pixels & Love,
Kris Krug
